title: Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy puts Nvidia’s China ambitions under scrutiny
reason: Major regulatory and geopolitical risk to a key AI infrastructure company with direct impact on chip export policy.

sources.summary: Jensen Huang’s alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy threatens to complicate Nvidia’s lobbying efforts to loosen U.S. chip export restrictions and maintain access to China’s lucrative AI market.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has until the end of the day Wednesday to answer a call from House Republicans for a closed-door briefing on his affair with alleged Chinese spy.
